exercises.question: Which sentence describes a present or future hypothetical?
options: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría. [If I had more time, I would travel.]
Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had had more time, I would have travelled.]
Tengo más tiempo. [I have more time.]

exercises.sentence: Si ___ más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
exercises.english: If I had had more information, I would have made a different decision.
If things had been different, I would have accepted.

sentences: Primero, no tenía la oportunidad. [First, I did not have the opportunity.]
Después, me quedé con la primera opción. [Then I stayed with the first option.]
Finalmente, pensé: «Si hubiera tenido la oportunidad, habría elegido otra opción». [Finally, I thought: “If I had had the opportunity, I would have chosen another option.”]

exercises.question: Which sentence describes a hypothetical consequence?
options: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If the plan changed, something different would happen.]
Si cambiaría el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I would change the plan, something different would happen.]
Si cambié el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I changed the plan, something different would happen.]

exercises.english: If it were possible, I would choose another alternative.
If I had taken another path, it would have been different.

exercises.question: Which sentence contains a condition about a past that did not happen?
options: Si hubiera sabido más, habría elegido otra opción. [If I had known more, I would have chosen another option.]
Si supiera más sobre el tema, elegiría otra opción. [If I knew more about the topic, I would choose another option.]
Si sé más sobre el tema, elijo otra opción. [If I know more about the topic, I choose another option.]
If I had more time, I would travel.
If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
I have more time and travel.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado.
options: If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
If I had more time, I would travel somewhere.
I travelled a lot because I had more time.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, habría sido diferente.
exercises.english: If I had taken another path, things would have been different.

options: Habría elegido otra opción. [I would have chosen another option.]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly contrasts the two hypothetical patterns?
options: Si tuviera tiempo, viajaría; si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had time, I would travel; if I had had time, I would have travelled.]
Si tuviera tiempo, viajé; si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had time, I travelled; if I had had time, I would have travelled.]
Si tendría tiempo, viajaría; si habría tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I would have time, I would travel; if I would have had time, I would have travelled.]

template.prompt: Say that if you had more time, you would travel.
Say that if you had had more information, you would have made another decision.
template.answer: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
